setupCard.description: Issue invoices in Subiekt nexo through the OpenLinker Sfera bridge running on your Windows machine.

regulatoryTransmissionTracking.help: Surface the bridge-reported regulatory transmission (KSeF) status on orders for this connection.
regulatoryTransmissionTracking.label: Show KSeF status badge

subiektCredentialsPanel.description: Stored securely on the server. Rotate to replace the bridge token without restarting the API.
subiektCredentialsPanel.label: Bridge token

toast.description: The new bridge token is now in use.
toast.title: Credentials rotated

subiektInvoiceCorrectionFlow.issuedBody: The correcting document was sent to Subiekt.
subiektInvoiceCorrectionFlow.linesRequired: At least one line with a line number is required.
subiektInvoiceCorrectionFlow.note: A correcting invoice (faktura korygująca) can adjust quantity and/or price per line - e.g. a returned unit or a post-sale price reduction. Subiekt transmits the correction to KSeF; OpenLinker tracks the status.
subiektInvoiceCorrectionFlow.title: Issue correction

subiektInvoiceDetailSection.note: Subiekt sent this to KSeF itself - OpenLinker reads the status, it doesn't transmit.
subiektInvoiceDetailSection.title: Regulatory status

cashRegister.error: Couldn't check Subiekt for cash registers - invoices will use the default register.
cashRegister.help: Invoices are always issued from the Centrala branch - the bridge does not support switching Oddział.
cashRegister.label: Cash register (Stanowisko Kasowe)

account.empty: No bank account is configured in Subiekt, so Transfer invoices will use whatever form Subiekt applies by default. Add an account under Konfiguracja systemu → Rachunki bankowe, then reload this page.
account.error: Couldn't check Subiekt for bank accounts - invoices will use whatever was last saved.
account.label: Bank account for Transfer invoices
account.multiPayerWarning: This Subiekt install has more than one płatnik. OpenLinker cannot yet confirm which płatnik an invoice is issued under, so the account picked here is not guaranteed to match the issuing payer.

method.help: Sent on every issued invoice. Leave unset to let Subiekt apply its own default; pick Transfer only when the seller has a bank account configured in Subiekt.
method.label: Default payment method
